tasks.title: Database Schema Design & Migration Setup
tasks.description: Design PostgreSQL schema for sessions, users, and findings. Set up Alembic migrations.
acceptance_criteria: PostgreSQL schema designed for sessions, users, findings

tasks.title: Session Persistence Layer
tasks.description: Replace in-memory session storage with PostgreSQL-backed persistence. Implement session repository pattern.
acceptance_criteria: Migration from in-memory to database seamless
Session cleanup job for expired sessions

tasks.title: Redis Integration for Caching & Rate Limiting
tasks.description: Add Redis for distributed caching and rate limiting state. Replace in-memory rate limiter.

tasks.title: HTTPS/TLS Configuration for Production
tasks.description: Implement HTTPS with proper TLS configuration. Set up certificate management.

tasks.title: Secrets Management Setup
tasks.description: Implement proper secrets management using environment variables and secret files. Add HashiCorp Vault support.
acceptance_criteria: No secrets in code or config files

tasks.title: React Error Boundaries Implementation
tasks.description: Add error boundaries at app and component level for graceful error handling.
acceptance_criteria: Root error boundary wraps entire app
User-friendly fallback UI with recovery options
Unit tests for error boundary behavior

tasks.title: API Error Handling Enhancement
tasks.description: Improve API error handling with retry logic, timeout handling, and better user feedback.
acceptance_criteria: Consistent error handling across all API calls
Network error detection and user feedback
Error type mapping to user messages

tasks.title: Backend Unit Test Coverage to 80%
tasks.description: Increase backend test coverage from 44% to 80%. Focus on uncovered modules.
acceptance_criteria: Edge cases covered for input validation

tasks.title: Frontend Test Coverage to 80%
tasks.description: Add Jest/React Testing Library tests for frontend components. Target 80% coverage.

tasks.title: E2E Testing Setup with Playwright
tasks.description: Set up Playwright for end-to-end testing. Create critical user flow tests.
acceptance_criteria: Playwright configured for Chrome, Firefox, Safari

tasks.title: Agent Tool Input Validation
tasks.description: Improve validation for agent tool inputs with schema validation and sanitization.
acceptance_criteria: JSON schema validation for tool inputs
Validation error messages for LLM self-correction
Unit tests for all tool validators

tasks.title: Agent Tool Execution Timeout & Safety
tasks.description: Add execution timeouts and safety limits for agent tools. Implement tool kill switch.
acceptance_criteria: Tool kill switch for emergency stop

tasks.title: API Documentation with OpenAPI/Swagger
tasks.description: Complete API documentation with OpenAPI specs, examples, and interactive docs.

tasks.title: Deployment & Operations Documentation
tasks.description: Create comprehensive deployment guide, operations runbook, and troubleshooting docs.

risks.description: Database migration may cause data loss if not carefully tested
risks.mitigation: Create migration scripts with rollback capability, test on staging first

risks.description: Redis dependency adds complexity and potential single point of failure
risks.mitigation: Implement fallback to in-memory cache, add Redis health checks

risks.description: Test coverage increase may take longer than estimated
risks.mitigation: Prioritize critical paths first, use coverage reports to guide focus

risks.description: HTTPS setup may have issues with existing infrastructure
risks.mitigation: Test in isolated environment first, document certificate process

risks.description: E2E tests may be flaky and slow down CI
risks.mitigation: Use deterministic test data, implement retry logic, run in parallel

definition_of_done: Unit tests passing with >80% coverage for new code
sprint_goals: Replace all in-memory session storage with PostgreSQL persistence
Achieve 80% test coverage across backend and frontend
Implement production-ready HTTPS and secrets management
Complete frontend error handling with error boundaries
Improve agent tool validation and safety
success_criteria: E2E tests passing for critical flows
